scene.label: Act 4, Scene 4
scene.title: SCENE IV. Wales. Before the cave of Belarius.
scene.location: Wales. Before the cave of Belarius.

lines.text: The noise is round about us.
lines.plainText: The noise is round about us

lines.text: Let us from it.
lines.plainText: Let us from it

lines.text: What pleasure, sir, find we in life, to lock it
lines.plainText: What pleasure sir find we in life to lock it

lines.text: From action and adventure?
lines.plainText: From action and adventure

lines.text: Nay, what hope
lines.plainText: Nay what hope

lines.text: Have we in hiding us? This way the Romans
lines.plainText: Have we in hiding us This way the Romans

lines.text: Must or for Britons slay us, or receive us
lines.plainText: Must or for Britons slay us or receive us

lines.text: For barbarous and unnatural revolts
lines.plainText: For barbarous and unnatural revolts

lines.text: During their use, and slay us after.
lines.plainText: During their use and slay us after

lines.text: Sons,
lines.plainText: Sons

lines.text: We'll higher to the mountains; there secure us.
lines.plainText: We'll higher to the mountains there secure us

lines.text: To the King's party there's no going. Newness
lines.plainText: To the King's party there's no going Newness

lines.text: Of Cloten's death (we being not known, not muster'd
lines.plainText: Of Cloten's death we being not known not muster'd

lines.text: Among the bands) may drive us to a render
lines.plainText: Among the bands may drive us to a render

lines.text: Where we have liv'd, and so extort from's that
lines.plainText: Where we have liv'd and so extort from's that

lines.text: Which we have done, whose answer would be death,
lines.plainText: Which we have done whose answer would be death

lines.text: Drawn on with torture.
lines.plainText: Drawn on with torture

lines.text: This is, sir, a doubt
lines.plainText: This is sir a doubt

lines.text: In such a time nothing becoming you
lines.plainText: In such a time nothing becoming you

lines.text: Nor satisfying us.
lines.plainText: Nor satisfying us

lines.text: It is not likely
lines.plainText: It is not likely

lines.text: That when they hear the Roman horses neigh,
lines.plainText: That when they hear the Roman horses neigh

lines.text: Behold their quarter'd fires, have both their eyes
lines.plainText: Behold their quarter'd fires have both their eyes

lines.text: And ears so cloy'd importantly as now,
lines.plainText: And ears so cloy'd importantly as now

lines.text: That they will waste their time upon our note,
lines.plainText: That they will waste their time upon our note

lines.text: To know from whence we are.
lines.plainText: To know from whence we are

lines.text: O, I am known
lines.plainText: O I am known

lines.text: Of many in the army. Many years,
lines.plainText: Of many in the army Many years

lines.text: Though Cloten then but young, you see, not wore him
lines.plainText: Though Cloten then but young you see not wore him

lines.text: From my remembrance. And, besides, the King
lines.plainText: From my remembrance And besides the King

lines.text: Hath not deserv'd my service nor your loves,
lines.plainText: Hath not deserv'd my service nor your loves

lines.text: Who find in my exile the want of breeding,
lines.plainText: Who find in my exile the want of breeding

lines.text: The certainty of this hard life; aye hopeless
lines.plainText: The certainty of this hard life aye hopeless

lines.text: To have the courtesy your cradle promis'd,
lines.plainText: To have the courtesy your cradle promis'd

lines.text: But to be still hot summer's tanlings and
lines.plainText: But to be still hot summer's tanlings and

lines.text: The shrinking slaves of winter.
lines.plainText: The shrinking slaves of winter

lines.text: Than be so,
lines.plainText: Than be so

lines.text: Better to cease to be. Pray, sir, to th' army.
lines.plainText: Better to cease to be Pray sir to th' army

lines.text: I and my brother are not known; yourself
lines.plainText: I and my brother are not known yourself

lines.text: So out of thought, and thereto so o'ergrown,
lines.plainText: So out of thought and thereto so o'ergrown

lines.text: Cannot be questioned.
lines.plainText: Cannot be questioned

lines.text: By this sun that shines,
lines.plainText: By this sun that shines

lines.text: I'll thither. What thing is't that I never
lines.plainText: I'll thither What thing is't that I never

lines.text: Did see man die! scarce ever look'd on blood
lines.plainText: Did see man die scarce ever look'd on blood

lines.text: But that of coward hares, hot goats, and venison!
lines.plainText: But that of coward hares hot goats and venison

lines.text: Never bestrid a horse, save one that had
lines.plainText: Never bestrid a horse save one that had

lines.text: A rider like myself, who ne'er wore rowel
lines.plainText: A rider like myself who ne'er wore rowel

lines.text: Nor iron on his heel! I am asham'd
lines.plainText: Nor iron on his heel I am asham'd

lines.text: To look upon the holy sun, to have
lines.plainText: To look upon the holy sun to have

lines.text: The benefit of his blest beams, remaining
lines.plainText: The benefit of his blest beams remaining

lines.text: So long a poor unknown.
lines.plainText: So long a poor unknown

lines.text: By heavens, I'll go!
lines.plainText: By heavens I'll go

lines.text: If you will bless me, sir, and give me leave,
lines.plainText: If you will bless me sir and give me leave

lines.text: I'll take the better care; but if you will not,
lines.plainText: I'll take the better care but if you will not

lines.text: The hazard therefore due fall on me by
lines.plainText: The hazard therefore due fall on me by

lines.text: The hands of Romans!
lines.plainText: The hands of Romans

lines.text: So say I. Amen.
lines.plainText: So say I Amen

lines.text: No reason I, since of your lives you set
lines.plainText: No reason I since of your lives you set

lines.text: So slight a valuation, should reserve
lines.plainText: So slight a valuation should reserve

lines.text: My crack'd one to more care. Have with you, boys!
lines.plainText: My crack'd one to more care Have with you boys

lines.text: If in your country wars you chance to die,
lines.plainText: If in your country wars you chance to die

lines.text: That is my bed too, lads, and there I'll lie.
lines.plainText: That is my bed too lads and there I'll lie

lines.text: Lead, lead. [Aside.] The time seems long; their blood thinks scorn
lines.plainText: Lead lead Aside The time seems long their blood thinks scorn

lines.text: Till it fly out and show them princes born.
lines.plainText: Till it fly out and show them princes born
